She stands on a comedy club stage, the chrome mic head just clipping into the bottom corner of the frame slightly out of focus, the warm red-brown brick back wall collapsed into deep velvet blackness behind her with only the faintest mortar texture catching a sliver of spill, a suggestion of a vertical mic stand shaft and a dark curtain edge dissolving into bokeh, dust motes drifting through the beam. Hard single front spotlight plus a punchy direct on-camera flash quality: hot specular highlights on damp skin, a bead of sweat glinting at her temple, crisp clean shadow edge under her jaw and cheekbone, glossy coral mouth reading as the single saturated accent against an otherwise black and neutral frame, highlights slightly warm, shadows dropping fast to true black with no diffusion.
